guidance.statement: Management targets about USD 100 million business in the electronic chemicals segment in 3-4 years.
guidance.quote: and in the electronic chemicals that we have stated, we are targeting about USD 100 billion business in 3-4 year’s time, and we are seeing the trajectory of that right now.

guidance.statement: Management expects gross margins to hold around 49% with an objective to continue improving over the next 2-3 quarters.
guidance.quote: 49% is what I am seeing the 2-3 quarters in this today I believe that keeping that and trying to improve that should be our objective in the next 2-3 quarters, continue to improve that and I do see that happen.

guidance.statement: Management expects contract assets to remain around Rs. 700 crores over the next few quarters.
guidance.quote: we are currently around Rs. 700 odd crore, and we expect to be in the same range.

guidance.statement: Agchem exports declined by 18% due to price optimization, genericization pressures, and unpassed cost escalations.
guidance.quote: Ag Chem exports declined by 18% during the period. We remained focused on driving volume growth post-genericization through price optimization while cost escalation could not be passed through in this current market conditions.

guidance.statement: Plant healthcare globally is expected to incur losses of about $10 plus million for the full year.
guidance.quote: It is about $10 plus million that we have lost there. For the full year.

guidance.statement: The weakest monsoon in over a decade and below-last-year soil moisture led management to plan for a cautious Rabi season.
guidance.quote: In India, the season was defined by the weakest monsoon in over a decade with prolonged dry spells, delayed sowing and, as a result, lower pest pressure. Kharif acreage was flat and the season was lacklustre. Going into rabi, soil moisture and reservoir levels are below last year in several rain-fed belts, so we are planning for a cautious Rabi and will respond to how the season actually develops.

guidance.statement: Domestic agri business delivered strong year-on-year growth of 19% supported by differentiated crop protection solutions.
guidance.quote: Our domestic business continues to hold its ground with strong year-on-year growth of 19% despite the challenging market dynamics, supported by a portfolio of differentiated high-value crop protection solutions and strong market position across key brands.

guidance.statement: Domestic biological portfolio grew by 45% and global biological portfolio grew by over 250% this quarter.
guidance.quote: Biologicals deserve a specific mention here. Our domestic portfolio has grown by 45% and our global portfolio has seen more than 250% growth this quarter as farmers continue to adopt sustainable solutions.

guidance.statement: Order book position stands around USD 1.25 billion.
guidance.quote: Order book position is around USD 1.25 billion.

guidance.statement: Management expects positive revenue growth trajectory in the lower single digit for FY27.
guidance.quote: You see, as stated earlier, we are looking at a positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier.

guidance.statement: Management expects the effective tax rate (ETR) for FY27 to be around 24%.
guidance.quote: We expect ETR for FY27 to be around 24%.

guidance.statement: Management guides for a standard annual capex of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore.
guidance.quote: We have given a guidance of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore, which is the standard capex as you rightly said.

guidance.statement: Management acknowledged pricing pressures due to challenged demand cycles, soft commodity prices, and high input costs.
guidance.quote: There are pressure on margins due to high input cost & higher levels of inventory, however we believe consumption patterns will see a positive trajectory.

guidance.statement: Management noted that the export operating environment remains challenging due to soft commodity prices, geopolitical uncertainties, and rising costs.
guidance.quote: With respect to our exports business, the operating environment continues to remain challenging. Soft commodity prices, in-line with impact of the previous year's industry downturn, and muted recovery in crop economics, consumption patterns continue to exert pressure on growth and pricing.

guidance.statement: Management reported a strong 50% aggressive growth in the biologicals segment.
guidance.quote: Biologicals have shown an aggressive growth of 50% with a three- year CAGR of 15%.

guidance.statement: Management achieved a reduction of 19 days in net working capital, releasing Rs. 300 crore of cash.
guidance.quote: Despite the challenging environment, the team delivered an impressive reduction of 19 days in net working capital, releasing INR 300 crore of cash.

guidance.statement: Management highlighted a strong debt-free balance sheet with a net cash position of INR 38 billion.
guidance.quote: Our strong debt-free balance sheet, supported with net cash of INR 38 billion, provides resilience and flexibility for strategic investments.

guidance.statement: Management expects positive revenue growth in fiscal 2027 driven by export recovery, new product launches, and scaling of pharma and biologicals.
guidance.quote: As we see the opportunities in FY27, we expect a positive growth in FY27 led by recovery in exports in the second half, supported by new product launches especially our first homegrown NCE in the domestic business and our pharma & biologicals continue to scale up.

guidance.statement: Management guides that the effective tax rate (ETR) will inch up to 24% from FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: We expect FY27 and thereafter ETR to inch upto 24%.

guidance.statement: Management targets reaching a top line of INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore in the pharma segment over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Obviously, the investment mindsets are shifting. As we have seen these things move and as we have stated earlier, achieving a INR 500 crore – INR 600 crore top line is when you would see these things move into a positive phase.

guidance.statement: Management guides for an annual capex spend of INR 700 to INR 800 crore covering manufacturing, new launches, and R&D.
guidance.quote: So, the capex would be as we have guided in the past also, we should have INR 700 to INR 800 crore of capex both at the manufacturing level, some of the new launches which we are going to be having, R&D spends across both pharma and our agrochemical business.

guidance.statement: Management targets achieving about $100 million in revenue in the electronic chemicals segment in the next 4 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: As we have stated earlier last year, we are looking to target about $100 million in the next 4 to 5 years in this segment.

guidance.statement: Management acknowledged that the global crop protection market has continued a multi-year downcycle with uneven recovery and just-in-time purchasing.
guidance.quote: The global crop protection market has continued the multi-year downcycle and recovery remains uneven further complicated by global events during the quarter which has led to clear shift towards just- in-time purchasing.

guidance.statement: Domestic industry demand has been impacted by elevated channel inventory, lower crop prices, and incessant rainfall.
guidance.quote: The domestic backdrop is genuinely encouraging on the fundamentals, even though near-term industry demand has been muted due to elevated channel inventory, lower crop prices and incessant rainfall.

guidance.statement: The pharma business delivered a strong 40% revenue growth for the full year.
guidance.quote: Our Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year.

guidance.statement: The global biologicals business has emerged as one of the fastest-growing segments, compounding at over 20%.
guidance.quote: Over the past few years this business has emerged as one of the fastest-growing segments within our portfolio compounding at over 20%+.

guidance.statement: The company maintained a debt-free balance sheet with a cash balance of INR 34,265 million.
guidance.quote: Our consolidated revenue for the full year FY26, we have delivered revenue of ₹ 67,137 million with healthy EBITDA margins of 25% and cash balance of INR 34,265 million enabling the company to pursue future strategic investments for long - term sustainable growth.

guidance.statement: Management continues to maintain its long-term gross profit margin guidance between 50% to 52%.
guidance.quote: As we guided in the past, we continue to maintain our long-term GP margin guidance between 50% to 52%, and we continue to move with that.

guidance.statement: The company is on track to commercialize 8 to 10 new molecules in total for the year.
guidance.quote: We are on track to commercialize 8 to 10 new molecules with 5 molecules already commercialized.

guidance.statement: The capex plan for FY27 will broadly be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore.
guidance.quote: So broadly, it will be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore.

guidance.statement: Management expects revenue growth to resume from FY27 onwards as industry conditions stabilize.
guidance.quote: We expect the domestic growth to be back on track from FY27 onwards.

guidance.statement: Product pricing continues to remain soft, particularly for the generic category.
guidance.quote: Product pricing continues to remain soft, particularly for the generic category.

guidance.statement: Domestic demand for key agrochemicals remained muted due to channel inventories and adverse weather.
guidance.quote: However, the demand for key agrochemicals during the quarter remained muted due to elevated channel inventories, adverse weather conditions, lower crop prices.

guidance.statement: Global biotech funding and geopolitical uncertainties lengthened decision cycles for pharma.
guidance.quote: Near term momentum, however, has been moderated due to global biotech funding and ongoing geopolitical uncertainties, which have lengthened decision cycles and slowed the conversion of select opportunities.

guidance.statement: Pharma business delivered a 50% year-on-year growth during the nine-month period.
guidance.quote: Now coming to Pharma, we have delivered a 50% year-on-year growth.

guidance.statement: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with net cash of INR 35 billion.
guidance.quote: Our debt-free balance sheet position supported with net cash of INR 35 billion provides strong resilience and flexibility for strategic investments.

guidance.statement: Gross margins expanded to 59% during the quarter supported by product mix and cost discipline.
guidance.quote: On other financial metrices, our gross margin expanded to 59% during the quarter, supported by a favorable product mix and cost discipline.

guidance.statement: Proactive raw material price increases led customers to pre-emptively import sodium nitrite and nitroaromatics directly, impacting plant utilization.

guidance.statement: EBIT for Advanced Intermediates dropped sequentially due to input price headwinds, customer volume variations, duties, and logistics costs.
guidance.quote: The sequential moderation in profitability reflects the headwinds from input prices, some variation in customer volumes as well as impact of duties, logistics and freight rates.

guidance.statement: Company achieved the best-ever performance in its operating history with record revenue and EBITDA on both quarterly and half-yearly bases.

guidance.statement: Phenolics segment EBIT in just the first six months surpassed the previous highest annual EBIT registered in FY22.
guidance.quote: I am sure many of you would have noticed that in just the first 6 months of this financial year, our EBIT of INR 933 crore has surpassed previous highest annual EBIT of INR 867 crore, which was registered in FY22.

guidance.statement: Deepak Chemtech commissioned chlorination, photohalogenation assets, and a specialty chemicals plant in Dahej with about INR 300 crore capital investment.
guidance.quote: Moreover, towards the end of the quarter, Deepak Chemtech also commissioned its chlorination, which is in addition to the photohalogenation assets as well as specialty chemicals plant in Dahej with capital investment of approximately INR 300 crore, including associated utilities and infra.

guidance.statement: Management expects to achieve a run rate of close to 4 lakh tonnes of phenol production in the short to medium term.
guidance.quote: We are looking at opportunities to debottleneck further. And hopefully, we should in the short to medium term, be able to achieve the big 4 number.

guidance.statement: MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone projects will be commissioned in August itself.
guidance.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.

guidance.statement: The company achieved its highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax of INR 7,967 million, growing 33% year-on-year.

guidance.statement: FMEG segment marked the tenth consecutive quarter of outperforming industry growth rates with 71% year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: This marks the tenth consecutive quarter in which we have outperformed industry growth rates, reinforcing the strength of our business model and execution capabilities.

guidance.statement: The company aims to increase the contribution of exports to its total revenue to over 10% by the financial year 2030.
guidance.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.

guidance.statement: The company is working towards achieving an EBITDA margin of 8% to 10% for the FMEG segment by financial year 2030.
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter stood at 4.1%, in line with our Project Spring trajectory of achieving 8% to 10% EBITDA margins by financial year 2030.

guidance.statement: The company plans to execute a capital expenditure program totaling INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next five years.
guidance.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years, which will further enhance our capabilities, scale and innovation.

guidance.statement: The company is targeting a dividend payout ratio exceeding 30% by the financial year 2030.
guidance.quote: This represents a step forward towards our Project Spring goal of achieving a 30% payout ratio by financial year 2030.

guidance.statement: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East negatively impacted export sales and trade sentiment during the quarter.
guidance.quote: The demand sentiment to an extent was impacted by geopolitical developments in the Middle East, but our teams executed with agility and resilience, enabling us to sustain an industry- leading performance.

guidance.statement: The company experienced significant volatility in raw material costs, specifically noting a sharp rise in PVC prices during March.
guidance.quote: So all of this going on plus the trade sentiment due to West Asia crisis, there was definitely some impact in terms of lifting from our distributors, which is our primary sale, primarily because the secondary sale was not moving at the pace at which we anticipate in the month of March.

guidance.statement: The company continued to gain market share in the domestic wires and cables segment, reaching 30-31%.
guidance.quote: Our domestic wires and cable organized market share has now increased to 30-31% up from 18- 19% in financial year 2019.

guidance.statement: The FMEG segment achieved strong growth, marking nine consecutive quarters of outperforming industry benchmarks.
guidance.quote: The FMEG segment delivered an exceptional performance for this quarter, registering a strong 47% year-on-year growth with broad-based contributions across all product categories. This marks the ninth consecutive quarter of outperformance versus industry benchmarks

guidance.statement: The company expects to generate ₹4.5 billion from existing BharatNet scheme orders over the next three years.
guidance.quote: This quarter, we commenced execution of our existing orders under BharatNet scheme, which is expected to generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution

guidance.statement: The company expects to generate ₹3.5 billion from BharatNet project operations and maintenance over the next decade.
guidance.quote: and an additional ₹ 3.5 billion for 10 years for project O&M.

guidance.statement: Management expects annual sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single digits.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.

guidance.statement: The company aims to achieve EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% for the FMEG segment by FY30.
guidance.quote: remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30

guidance.statement: The company plans to invest between ₹12 billion and ₹16 billion annually in capital expenditure through FY30.
guidance.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.

guidance.statement: Sharp increases in copper and aluminium prices created near-term margin pressure as the company staggered price pass-throughs.
guidance.quote: Segment profitability was impacted during the quarter due to multiple factors, primarily on account of continued commodity price inflation and depreciation of the Indian rupee.

guidance.statement: Elevated U.S. tariffs are acting as a global overhang and impacting the company's export performance.
guidance.quote: This remains a global overhang and is impacting players worldwide, not just in India. We are currently awaiting a final resolution on this matter.

guidance.statement: The domestic Wires and Cables business achieved strong volume growth of 40% during the quarter.
guidance.quote: In volume, the domestic W&C business recorded nearly 40% growth, reflecting healthy underlying demand.

guidance.statement: The solar business segment more than doubled its performance compared to the same quarter last year.
guidance.quote: Within the segment, the solar business has been a standout performer, growing more than 2x compared to the same quarter last year

guidance.quote: At the PAT level, the Company delivered its highest ever Q3 PAT at ₹ 6.3 billion, reflecting 36% YoY growth.

guidance.statement: The company expects to generate between INR450 crores and INR500 crores in revenue from its OSAT and PCB businesses for the full financial year.

guidance.statement: Management confirms that both the OSAT and PCB units are on track to become operational by the third quarter of the current financial year.
